1: Armino AI Solution Introduction
2: ------------------------------------
3: 
4: :link_to_translation:`zh_CN:[中文]`
5: 
6: Overview
7: -----------------------------------
8: 
9: Armino AI Solution is an intelligent AI device solution developed by Beken Corporation based on the Armino SMP architecture. This solution provides complete end-to-cloud and cloud-to-large-model AI interaction capabilities, supports multiple large language model integrations, and offers developers a complete development framework for rapidly building intelligent AI devices. Currently supports large model applications such as VolcEngine and Agora.
10: 
11: 
12: Project Compilation
13: ------------------------------------
14: 
15: 1. Environment Setup
16: ,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,
17: 
18: 1.1  **Download Armino SMP SDK**:
19: 
20: You can download Armino SMP code from gitlab::
21: 
22:     mkdir -p ~/armino
23:     cd ~/armino
24:     git clone https://gitlab.bekencorp.com/armino/bk_avdk_smp.git -b release/v3.1.1
25: 
26: 1.2 **Download AI Solution Code**:
27: 
28: You can download Armino AI Solution code from gitlab::
29: 
30:     mkdir -p ~/armino
31:     cd ~/armino
32:     git clone https://gitlab.bekencorp.com/armino/smp_solution/bk_solution_ai.git -b release/v3.1.1
33: 
34: 
35: 2. Project Introduction
36: --------------------------------
37: Armino AI Solution mainly includes Agora RTC version project, VolcEngine RTC version project, and AI camera version project.
38: 
39: Agora RTC Version Project (beken_genie)
40: ,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,
41: 
42: An AI device solution based on BK7258 chip and Agora RTC SDK, providing complete end-to-cloud and cloud-to-large-model AI interaction capabilities.
43: - Supports Agora RTC real-time audio/video communication, integrated audio processing engine (AEC, NS, KWS)
44: - Supports OPUS, PCM audio encoding formats, supports prompt tone playback
45: - Supports multiple large language model integrations (OpenAI, Doubao, DeepSeek, etc.)
46: - Supports dual SPI LCD screen display, providing visual and voice interaction experience
47: - Includes rich peripheral reference designs: gyroscope, NFC, buttons, vibration motor, NAND Flash, LED effects, charging management, DVP camera, etc.
48: 
49: VolcEngine RTC Version Project (volc_rtc)
50: ,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,
51: 
52: A real-time audio/video communication solution based on BK7258 chip and VolcEngine RTC SDK, supporting real-time conversation with cloud AI Agent.
53: - Supports VolcEngine RTC real-time audio/video communication, integrated audio processing engine (AEC, NS)
54: - Supports G722, OPUS, PCM audio encoding formats
55: - Supports VolcEngine AI Agent service integration, supports voice conversation and image recognition
56: - Supports dual SPI LCD screen display, providing visual and voice interaction experience
57: - Includes rich peripheral reference designs: gyroscope, NFC, buttons, vibration motor, NAND Flash, LED effects, charging management, DVP camera, etc.
58: 
59: AI Camera Version Project (ai_camera)
60: ,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,
61: 
62: AI camera solution, currently under development.

65: 3. Compile Project
66: ,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,
67: 
68: **Method 1: Direct Compilation**
69:

103: 4. Flash Firmware to Device
104: ,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,
105: 
106: After compilation, the all-app.bin file will be generated in the /build/bk7258/beken_genie/package directory of the AI Solution code. Use the flashing tool to flash it to the development board.
107: 
108: 4.1 **Resource File Flashing**
109: 
110:     - 1. Armino supports firmware flashing on Windows/Linux platforms. Refer to the flashing tool documentation for flashing methods. For Windows platform, Armino currently supports UART flashing.
111: 
112:       For specific `flashing procedures <https://docs.bekencorp.com/arminodoc/bk_avdk_smp/smp_doc/bk7258/en/v3.1.1/get-started/index.html>`_, please refer to `SMP <https://docs.bekencorp.com/arminodoc/bk_avdk_smp/smp_doc/bk7258/en/v3.1.1/index.html>`_

115: 5. Project Demo and Operation Steps

9: Armino AI Solution is an intelligent AI device solution developed by Beken Corporation based on the Armino SMP architecture. 39: Agora RTC Version Project (beken_genie)
40: ,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,
41: 
42: An AI device solution based on BK7258 chip and Agora RTC SDK, providing complete end-to-cloud and cloud-to-large-model AI interaction capabilities.

46: - Supports dual SPI LCD screen display, providing visual and voice interaction experience
47: - Includes rich peripheral reference designs: gyroscope, NFC, buttons, vibration motor, NAND Flash, LED effects, charging management, DVP camera, etc.

49: VolcEngine RTC Version Project (volc_rtc)
50: ,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,
51: 
52: A real-time audio/video communication solution based on BK7258 chip and VolcEngine RTC SDK, supporting real-time conversation with cloud AI Agent.
53: - Supports VolcEngine RTC real-time audio/video communication, integrated audio processing engine (AEC, NS)
54: - Supports G722, OPUS, PCM audio encoding formats
55: - Supports VolcEngine AI Agent service integration, supports voice conversation and image recognition
56: - Supports dual SPI LCD screen display, providing visual and voice interaction experience
57: - Includes rich peripheral reference designs: gyroscope, NFC, buttons, vibration motor, NAND Flash, LED effects, charging management, DVP camera, etc.

60: ,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,

1: # Beken Genie AI Solution DEMO Development Guide
2: 
3: * [中文](./README_CN.md)
4: 
5: ## 1 Project Overview
6: 
7: This project is a general-purpose AI device solution framework based on the BK7258 chip, providing complete end-to-cloud and cloud-to-large-model AI interaction capabilities. The project supports Agora RTC solution, integrating audio processing engine, network transfer module, event management system, and rich peripheral support. It is suitable for developing intelligent AI devices, voice assistants, smart speakers, and other application scenarios.
8: 
9: ## 2 Features
10: 
11: ### 2.1 Real-time Audio/Video Communication
12: - Supports bidirectional audio/video communication
13: - Supports multiple audio/video streams
14: - Supports adaptive bitrate control (BWE)
15: - Supports key frame request mechanism
16: 
17: ### 2.2 Audio Processing
18: - Supports multiple audio encoding formats:
19:   - OPUS (recommended)
20:   - PCM
21: - Supports AEC (Acoustic Echo Cancellation)
22: - Supports NS (Noise Suppression)
23: - Supports KWS (Keyword Wake-up)
24: - Supports audio capture and playback
25: - Supports prompt tone playback
26: 
27: ### 2.3 Video Processing (Optional)
28: - Supports H264 encoding
29: - Supports JPEG encoding
30: - Supports video capture and transmission
31: - Supports image recognition
32: 
33: ### 2.4 Network Functions
34: - Supports WiFi STA mode connection
35: - Supports WiFi AP mode hotspot
36: - Supports Bluetooth network configuration
37: - Supports TCP/UDP protocols
38: - Supports HTTP/HTTPS requests
39: 
40: ### 2.5 AI Agent Integration
41: - Supports integration with multiple AI Agent services
42: - Supports voice conversation and image recognition
43: - Supports Agent start, stop, and update
44: - Supports starting Agent from BK server or custom server
45: - Supports multiple large language models (OpenAI, Doubao, DeepSeek, etc.)
46: 
47: ### 2.6 Room Management
48: - Supports joining/leaving RTC rooms
49: - Supports user online/offline notifications
50: - Supports Token permission management
51: - Supports Token expiration warning and automatic refresh
52: 
53: ### 2.7 Peripheral Support

1: # VolcEngine RTC Solution DEMO Development Guide
2: 
3: * [中文](./README_CN.md)
4: 
5: ## 1 Project Overview
6: 
7: This project is a real-time audio/video communication solution based on BK7258 chip and VolcEngine RTC SDK, implementing audio/video data transmission through WiFi and supporting real-time conversation with cloud AI Agent. The project integrates VolcEngine RTC SDK, audio processing engine, network transfer module, and event management system. It is suitable for developing intelligent AI devices, voice assistants, and other application scenarios.
8: 
9: ## 2 Features
10: 
11: ### 2.1 Real-time Audio/Video Communication
12: - Supports bidirectional audio/video communication
13: - Supports multiple audio/video streams
14: - Supports adaptive bitrate control (BWE)
15: - Supports key frame request mechanism
16: 
17: ### 2.2 Audio Processing
18: - Supports multiple audio encoding formats:
19:   - G.722
20:   - OPUS (recommended)
21:   - PCM
22: - Supports AEC (Acoustic Echo Cancellation)
23: - Supports NS (Noise Suppression)
24: - Supports audio capture and playback
25: 
26: ### 2.3 Video Processing (Optional)
27: - Supports H264 encoding
28: - Supports JPEG encoding
29: - Supports video capture and transmission
30: 
31: ### 2.4 Network Functions
32: - Supports WiFi STA mode connection
33: - Supports WiFi AP mode hotspot
34: - Supports TCP/UDP protocols
35: - Supports HTTP/HTTPS requests
36: 
37: ### 2.5 AI Agent Integration
38: - Supports integration with VolcEngine AI Agent service
39: - Supports voice conversation and image recognition
40: - Supports Agent start, stop, and update
41: - Supports starting Agent from BK server or custom server
42: 
43: ### 2.6 Room Management
44: - Supports joining/leaving RTC rooms
45: - Supports user online/offline notifications
46: - Supports Token permission management
47: - Supports Token expiration warning and automatic refresh
48: 
49: ## 3 Quick Start
50: 
51: ### 3.1 Compilation and Flashing
52: 
53: Compilation process reference: `AI Solution <../../README_CN.md>`_
54: 
55: Flashing process reference: For specific `flashing procedures <https://docs.bekencorp.com/arminodoc/bk_avdk_smp/smp_doc/bk7258/en/v3.1.1/get-started/index.html>`_, please refer to `SMP <https://docs.bekencorp.com/arminodoc/bk_avdk_smp/smp_doc/bk7258/en/v3.1.1/index.html>`_
56: 
57: The compiled firmware bin file path: ``projects/volc_rtc/build/bk7258/volc_rtc/package/all-app.bin``
58: 
59: **Compilation command example:**
60: 
61: ```bash
62: cd ~/armino/bk_solution_ai/projects/volc_rtc
63: export SDK_DIR=~/armino/bk_avdk_smp
64: make clean
65: make bk7258
66: ```
67: 
68: 
69: ## 4 API Reference
70: 
71: This section provides API interface descriptions for core functions in the project. These interfaces implement advanced function calls by encapsulating the VolcEngine RTC SDK.
72: 
73: .. note::
74: 
75:    It is recommended that developers do not directly call the following interfaces to implement custom solutions, but rather refer to the implementation of these interfaces and build functional modules that meet their own needs by combining and encapsulating SDK interfaces.
76: 
77: 
78: ### 4.1 Agent Management API
79: 
80: #### 4.1.1 bk_byte_agent_start
81: ```c
82: /**
83:  * @brief Start AI Agent service
84:  * 
85:  * @param room_info Room information structure pointer (output parameter)
86:  *        - Function will fill App ID, Room ID, Token and other information
87:  * 
88:  * @param device_id Device ID string
89:  * 
90:  * @return int Operation result
91:  *         - BK_OK: Start successful
92:  *         - BK_FAIL: Start failed
93:  * 
94:  * @note This function will:
95:  *       1. Select to start from BK server or custom server according to configuration
96:  *       2. Send HTTP request to server
97:  *       3. Parse response to get room information
98:  *       4. Fill room_info structure
99:  * 
100:  * @warning Before calling this function, ensure that network connection is normal
101:  * 
102:  * @see bk_byte_agent_stop()
103:  */
104: int bk_byte_agent_start(byte_rtc_room_info_t *room_info, void *device_id);
105: ```
106: 
107: #### 4.1.2 bk_byte_agent_stop
108: ```c
109: /**
110:  * @brief Stop AI Agent service
111:  * 
112:  * @param room_info Room information structure pointer
113:  * @param device_id Device ID string
114:  * 
115:  * @return int Operation result
116:  *         - BK_OK: Stop successful
117:  *         - BK_FAIL: Stop failed
118:  * 
119:  * @note This function will:
120:  *       1. Select to stop from BK server or custom server according to configuration
121:  *       2. Send HTTP request to server
122:  *       3. Clean up local resources
123:  * 
124:  * @see bk_byte_agent_start()
125:  */
126: int bk_byte_agent_stop(byte_rtc_room_info_t *room_info, void *device_id);
127: ```
128: 
129: ### 4.2 Advanced API
130: 
131: #### 4.2.1 bk_byte_start
132: ```c
133: /**
134:  * @brief Start complete RTC and Agent service
135:  * 
136:  * @param device_id Device ID string
137:  * 
138:  * @return int Operation result
139:  *         - BK_OK: Start successful
140:  *         - BK_FAIL: Start failed
141:  * 
142:  * @note This function will:
143:  *       1. Mount SD card file system (if License is enabled)
144:  *       2. Start AI Agent service (get room information)
145:  *       3. Initialize RTC engine
146:  *       4. Join RTC room
147:  *       5. Start audio/video transmission
148:  * 
149:  * @warning This is an advanced interface that will start both Agent and RTC
150:  * 
151:  * @see bk_byte_stop()
152:  */
153: int bk_byte_start(void *device_id);
154: ```
155: 
156: #### 4.2.2 bk_byte_stop
157: ```c
158: /**
159:  * @brief Stop complete RTC and Agent service
160:  * 
161:  * @param device_id Device ID string
162:  * 
163:  * @return int Operation result
164:  *         - BK_OK: Stop successful
165:  *         - BK_FAIL: Stop failed
166:  * 
167:  * @note This function will:
168:  *       1. Stop RTC service (leave room, destroy engine)
169:  *       2. Stop AI Agent service
170:  *       3. Release room information memory
171:  *       4. Unmount SD card file system
172:  * 
173:  * @see bk_byte_start()
174:  */
175: int bk_byte_stop(void *device_id);
176: ```
177: 
178: ### 4.3 Audio/Video Sending API
179: 
180: #### 4.3.1 byte_rtc_send_audio
181: ```c
182: /**
183:  * @brief Send audio data to RTC room
184:  * 
185:  * @param engine RTC engine handle
186:  * @param room Room ID string
187:  * @param data Audio data pointer
188:  * @param data_len Audio data length
189:  * 
190:  * @return int Operation result
191:  *         - 0: Send successful
192:  *         - <0: Send failed
193:  * 
194:  * @note This function will:
195:  *       1. Check RTC engine and room status
196:  *       2. Call SDK interface to send audio data
197:  *       3. Automatically handle encoding format conversion
198:  * 
199:  * @warning Before calling this function, ensure that room has been joined
200:  * 
201:  * @see byte_rtc_send_video()
202:  */
203: int byte_rtc_send_audio(byte_rtc_engine_t engine, 
204:                         const char *room, 
205:                         const void *data, 
206:                         size_t data_len);
207: ```
208: 
209: #### 4.3.2 byte_rtc_send_video
210: ```c
211: /**
212:  * @brief Send video data to RTC room
213:  * 
214:  * @param engine RTC engine handle
215:  * @param room Room ID string
216:  * @param data Video data pointer
217:  * @param data_len Video data length
218:  * @param codec Video encoding format
219:  * 
220:  * @return int Operation result
221:  *         - 0: Send successful
222:  *         - <0: Send failed
223:  * 
224:  * @note This function will:
225:  *       1. Check RTC engine and room status
226:  *       2. Construct video frame information
227:  *       3. Call SDK interface to send video data
228:  * 
229:  * @warning Before calling this function, ensure that room has been joined
230:  * 
231:  * @see byte_rtc_send_audio()
232:  */
233: int byte_rtc_send_video(byte_rtc_engine_t engine, 
234:                         const char *room, 
235:                         const void *data, 
236:                         size_t data_len, 
237:                         video_data_type_e codec);
238: ```
239: 
240: 
241: ## 5 For detailed project introduction and guide, please refer to the following links
242: 
243: - `Armino SMP SDK Documentation <https://docs.bekencorp.com/arminodoc/bk_avdk_smp/smp_doc/bk7258/en/v3.1.1/index.html>`_

1: # Audio Engine Module
2: 
3: A high-level audio engine module that provides simplified APIs for audio start/stop operations, built on top of the bk_voice_service infrastructure.
4: 
5: ## Features
6: 
7: - **Simplified API**: Easy-to-use `audio_engine_start()` and `audio_engine_stop()` functions
8: - **Comprehensive Error Handling**: Detailed error codes for easy debugging
9: - **Flexible Configuration**: Support for various microphone/speaker types and audio processing features
10: - **Thread Safety**: Proper resource management and state tracking
11: - **Callback Support**: Event and data read callbacks for real-time audio processing
12: 
13: ## API Overview
14: 
15: ### Core Functions
16: 
17: - `int audio_engine_start(audio_engine_cfg_t *cfg)` - Start audio engine with configuration
18: - `int audio_engine_stop(void)` - Stop audio engine and cleanup resources
19: - `bool audio_engine_is_running(void)` - Check if audio engine is running
20: - `int audio_engine_write_data(const uint8_t *data, uint32_t size, uint32_t timeout_ms)` - Write audio data to speaker
21: - `const char *audio_engine_err_to_str(int err)` - Convert error code to string
22: 
23: ### Configuration Structure
24: 
25: ```c
26: typedef struct {
27:     /* Microphone configuration */
28:     mic_type_t mic_type;           // MIC_TYPE_ONBOARD, MIC_TYPE_UAC, MIC_TYPE_ONBOARD_DUAL_DMIC_MIC
29:     uint32_t mic_sample_rate;      // 8000 or 16000
30:     
31:     /* Speaker configuration */
32:     spk_type_t spk_type;           // SPK_TYPE_ONBOARD or SPK_TYPE_UAC
33:     uint32_t spk_sample_rate;      // 8000 or 16000
34:     
35:     /* Audio processing */
36:     uint8_t aec_enable;            // 0: disable, 1: enable AEC
37:     uint8_t eq_enable;             // 0: disable, 1: mono EQ, 2: stereo EQ
38:     
39:     /* Encoding/Decoding */
40:     audio_enc_type_t enc_type;     // AUDIO_ENC_TYPE_PCM, AUDIO_ENC_TYPE_G711A, AUDIO_ENC_TYPE_G711U
41:     audio_dec_type_t dec_type;     // AUDIO_DEC_TYPE_PCM, AUDIO_DEC_TYPE_G711A, AUDIO_DEC_TYPE_G711U
42:     
43:     /* Callback functions */
44:     voice_event_handle event_cb;   // Voice event callback function
45:     audio_engine_read_callback_t read_cb; // Audio engine read callback function
46:     void *user_data;               // User data for callbacks
47: } audio_engine_cfg_t;
48: ```
49: 
50: ### Error Codes
51: 
52: | Error Code | Description |
53: |------------|-------------|
54: | AUDIO_ENGINE_SUCCESS | Success |
55: | AUDIO_ENGINE_ERR_INVALID_PARAM | Invalid parameters |
56: | AUDIO_ENGINE_ERR_NOT_STARTED | Audio engine not started |
57: | AUDIO_ENGINE_ERR_VOICE_INIT | Voice init failed |
58: | AUDIO_ENGINE_ERR_READ_INIT | Voice read init failed |
59: | AUDIO_ENGINE_ERR_WRITE_INIT | Voice write init failed |
60: | AUDIO_ENGINE_ERR_VOICE_START | Voice start failed |
61: | AUDIO_ENGINE_ERR_READ_START | Voice read start failed |
62: | AUDIO_ENGINE_ERR_WRITE_START | Voice write start failed |
63: | AUDIO_ENGINE_ERR_VOICE_STOP | Voice stop failed |
64: | AUDIO_ENGINE_ERR_READ_STOP | Voice read stop failed |
65: | AUDIO_ENGINE_ERR_WRITE_STOP | Voice write stop failed |
66: 
67: ## Quick Start
68: 
69: ### Basic Usage
70: 
71: ```c
72: #include "audio_engine.h"
73: 
74: /* Callback functions */
75: static void voice_read_callback(const uint8_t *data, uint32_t size, void *args)
76: {
77:     /* Process received audio data */
78: }
79: 
80: static bk_err_t voice_event_callback(voice_evt_t event, void *data, void *args)
81: {
82:     /* Handle voice events */
83:     return BK_OK;
84: }
85: 
86: int main(void)
87: {
88:     audio_engine_cfg_t cfg = {
89:         .mic_type = MIC_TYPE_ONBOARD,
90:         .mic_sample_rate = 16000,
91:         .spk_type = SPK_TYPE_ONBOARD,
92:         .spk_sample_rate = 16000,
93:         .aec_enable = 1,
94:         .eq_enable = 0,
95:         .enc_type = AUDIO_ENC_TYPE_G711A,
96:         .dec_type = AUDIO_DEC_TYPE_G711A,
97:         .event_cb = voice_event_callback,
98:         .read_cb = voice_read_callback,
99:         .user_data = NULL
100:     };
101: 
102:     /* Start audio engine */
103:     int ret = audio_engine_start(&cfg);
104:     if (ret != AUDIO_ENGINE_SUCCESS) {
105:         printf("Failed to start: %s\n", audio_engine_err_to_str(ret));
106:         return ret;
107:     }
108: 
109:     /* Audio engine is now running */
110:     
111:     /* Stop audio engine when done */
112:     ret = audio_engine_stop();
113:     if (ret != AUDIO_ENGINE_SUCCESS) {
114:         printf("Failed to stop: %s\n", audio_engine_err_to_str(ret));
115:         return ret;
116:     }
117: 
118:     return AUDIO_ENGINE_SUCCESS;
119: }
120: ```
121: 
122: ### Error Handling
123: 
124: ```c
125: int ret = audio_engine_start(&cfg);
126: if (ret != AUDIO_ENGINE_SUCCESS) {
127:     const char *error_msg = audio_engine_err_to_str(ret);
128:     printf("Error %d: %s\n", ret, error_msg);
129:     
130:     switch (ret) {
131:         case AUDIO_ENGINE_ERR_INVALID_PARAM:
132:             /* Handle invalid parameters */
133:             break;
134:         case AUDIO_ENGINE_ERR_VOICE_INIT:
135:             /* Handle voice init failure */
136:             break;
137:         /* ... other error cases */
138:     }
139: }
140: ```
141: 
142: ## Examples
143: 
144: The module includes comprehensive examples in `audio_engine_example.c`:
145: 
146: 1. **Basic voice call** - Simple onboard mic/speaker configuration
147: 2. **High quality voice call** - Dual DMIC with EQ processing
148: 3. **UAC audio configuration** - USB Audio Class device support
149: 4. **Error handling demonstration** - Proper error checking and reporting
150: 5. **Status checking** - Runtime status monitoring
151: 
152: ## Build Instructions
153: 
154: Add the following to your component.mk:
155: 
156: ```makefile
157: COMPONENT_ADD_INCLUDEDIRS := audio_engine
158: COMPONENT_SRCDIRS := audio_engine
159: ```
160: 
161: ## Dependencies
162: 
163: - bk_voice_service
164: - bk_voice_read_service  
165: - bk_voice_write_service
166: - os layer
167: - audio driver kit components
168: 
169: ## License
170: 
171: Apache License 2.0
172: 
173: ## Support
174: 
175: For issues and questions, please refer to the audio service documentation or contact the development team.

1: # Audio Engine 模块
2: 
3: 基于 bk_voice_service 基础设施构建的高级音频引擎模块，提供简化的音频启动/停止操作 API。
4: 
5: ## 特性
6: 
7: - **简化 API**：易于使用的 `audio_engine_start()` 和 `audio_engine_stop()` 函数
8: - **完整错误处理**：详细的错误代码，便于调试
9: - **灵活配置**：支持多种麦克风/扬声器类型和音频处理功能
10: - **线程安全**：正确的资源管理和状态跟踪
11: - **回调支持**：事件和数据读取回调，用于实时音频处理
12: 
13: ## API 概述
14: 
15: ### 核心函数
16: 
17: - `int audio_engine_start(audio_engine_cfg_t *cfg)` - 使用配置启动音频引擎
18: - `int audio_engine_stop(void)` - 停止音频引擎并清理资源
19: - `bool audio_engine_is_running(void)` - 检查音频引擎是否正在运行
20: - `int audio_engine_write_data(const uint8_t *data, uint32_t size, uint32_t timeout_ms)` - 向扬声器写入音频数据
21: - `const char *audio_engine_err_to_str(int err)` - 将错误代码转换为字符串
22: 
23: ### 配置结构体
24: 
25: ```c
26: typedef struct {
27:     /* 麦克风配置 */
28:     mic_type_t mic_type;           // MIC_TYPE_ONBOARD, MIC_TYPE_UAC, MIC_TYPE_ONBOARD_DUAL_DMIC_MIC
29:     uint32_t mic_sample_rate;      // 8000 或 16000
30:     
31:     /* 扬声器配置 */
32:     spk_type_t spk_type;           // SPK_TYPE_ONBOARD 或 SPK_TYPE_UAC
33:     uint32_t spk_sample_rate;      // 8000 或 16000
34:     
35:     /* 音频处理 */
36:     uint8_t aec_enable;            // 0: 禁用, 1: 启用 AEC
37:     uint8_t eq_enable;             // 0: 禁用, 1: 单声道 EQ, 2: 立体声 EQ
38:     
39:     /* 编码/解码 */
40:     audio_enc_type_t enc_type;     // AUDIO_ENC_TYPE_PCM, AUDIO_ENC_TYPE_G711A, AUDIO_ENC_TYPE_G711U
41:     audio_dec_type_t dec_type;     // AUDIO_DEC_TYPE_PCM, AUDIO_DEC_TYPE_G711A, AUDIO_DEC_TYPE_G711U
42:     
43:     /* 回调函数 */
44:     voice_event_handle event_cb;   // 语音事件回调函数
45:     audio_engine_read_callback_t read_cb; // 语音读取回调函数
46:     void *user_data;               // 用户数据，用于回调
47: } audio_engine_cfg_t;
48: ```
49: 
50: ### 错误代码
51: 
52: | 错误代码 | 描述 |
53: |------------|-------------|
54: | AUDIO_ENGINE_SUCCESS | 成功 |
55: | AUDIO_ENGINE_ERR_INVALID_PARAM | 无效参数 |
56: | AUDIO_ENGINE_ERR_NOT_STARTED | 音频引擎未启动 |
57: | AUDIO_ENGINE_ERR_VOICE_INIT | 语音初始化失败 |
58: | AUDIO_ENGINE_ERR_READ_INIT | 语音读取初始化失败 |
59: | AUDIO_ENGINE_ERR_WRITE_INIT | 语音写入初始化失败 |
60: | AUDIO_ENGINE_ERR_VOICE_START | 语音启动失败 |
61: | AUDIO_ENGINE_ERR_READ_START | 语音读取启动失败 |
62: | AUDIO_ENGINE_ERR_WRITE_START | 语音写入启动失败 |
63: | AUDIO_ENGINE_ERR_VOICE_STOP | 语音停止失败 |
64: | AUDIO_ENGINE_ERR_READ_STOP | 语音读取停止失败 |
65: | AUDIO_ENGINE_ERR_WRITE_STOP | 语音写入停止失败 |
66: 
67: ## 快速开始
68: 
69: ### 基本用法
70: 
71: ```c
72: #include "audio_engine.h"
73: 
74: /* 回调函数 */
75: static void voice_read_callback(const uint8_t *data, uint32_t size, void *args)
76: {
77:     /* 处理接收到的音频数据 */
78: }
79: 
80: static bk_err_t voice_event_callback(voice_evt_t event, void *data, void *args)
81: {
82:     /* 处理语音事件 */
83:     return BK_OK;
84: }
85: 
86: int main(void)
87: {
88:     audio_engine_cfg_t cfg = {
89:         .mic_type = MIC_TYPE_ONBOARD,
90:         .mic_sample_rate = 16000,
91:         .spk_type = SPK_TYPE_ONBOARD,
92:         .spk_sample_rate = 16000,
93:         .aec_enable = 1,
94:         .eq_enable = 0,
95:         .enc_type = AUDIO_ENC_TYPE_G711A,
96:         .dec_type = AUDIO_DEC_TYPE_G711A,
97:         .event_cb = voice_event_callback,
98:         .read_cb = voice_read_callback,
99:         .user_data = NULL
100:     };
101: 
102:     /* 启动音频引擎 */
103:     int ret = audio_engine_start(&cfg);
104:     if (ret != AUDIO_ENGINE_SUCCESS) {
105:         printf("启动失败: %s\n", audio_engine_err_to_str(ret));
106:         return ret;
107:     }
108: 
109:     /* 音频引擎现在正在运行 */
110:     
111:     /* 完成后停止音频引擎 */
112:     ret = audio_engine_stop();
113:     if (ret != AUDIO_ENGINE_SUCCESS) {
114:         printf("停止失败: %s\n", audio_engine_err_to_str(ret));
115:         return ret;
116:     }
117: 
118:     return AUDIO_ENGINE_SUCCESS;
119: }
120: ```
121: 
122: ### 错误处理
123: 
124: ```c
125: int ret = audio_engine_start(&cfg);
126: if (ret != AUDIO_ENGINE_SUCCESS) {
127:     const char *error_msg = audio_engine_err_to_str(ret);
128:     printf("错误 %d: %s\n", ret, error_msg);
129:     
130:     switch (ret) {
131:         case AUDIO_ENGINE_ERR_INVALID_PARAM:
132:             /* 处理无效参数 */
133:             break;
134:         case AUDIO_ENGINE_ERR_VOICE_INIT:
135:             /* 处理语音初始化失败 */
136:             break;
137:         /* ... 其他错误情况 */
138:     }
139: }
140: ```
141: 
142: ## 示例
143: 
144: 模块在 `audio_engine_example.c` 中包含全面的示例：
145: 
146: 1. **基本语音通话** - 简单的板载麦克风/扬声器配置
147: 2. **高质量语音通话** - 双 DMIC 带 EQ 处理
148: 3. **UAC 音频配置** - USB 音频类设备支持
149: 4. **错误处理演示** - 正确的错误检查和报告
150: 5. **状态检查** - 运行时状态监控
151: 
152: ## 构建说明
153: 
154: 在您的 component.mk 中添加以下内容：
155: 
156: ```makefile
157: COMPONENT_ADD_INCLUDEDIRS := audio_engine

1: # Video Engine 模块
2: 
3: ## 📋 概述
4: 
5: Video Engine 提供了简洁的视频引擎管理接口，支持 DVP 摄像头的初始化、启动、停止和资源清理。所有配置基于 CONFIG 宏自动设置，使用简单方便。
6: 
7: ## 🎯 核心功能
8: 
9: - ✅ 自动配置（基于 CONFIG 宏）
10: - ✅ 一键初始化（video_engine_init）
11: - ✅ 状态管理（is_started 标志）
12: - ✅ 完整的生命周期管理（init/start/stop/deinit）
13: - ✅ 状态查询（video_engine_is_running）
14: - ✅ 完善的错误处理和资源清理
15: 
16: ## 🏗️ 架构设计
17: 
18: ### 1. 核心组件
19: 
20: ```
21: video_engine_ctx_t (上下文结构)
22:   ├─ camera_handle         摄像头句柄
23:   ├─ transfer_format       传输格式 (IMAGE_MJPEG/IMAGE_H264)
24:   ├─ transfer_task_handle  传输任务句柄
25:   ├─ transfer_task_running 传输任务运行标志
26:   └─ is_started           引擎启动状态标志
27: ```
28: 
29: ### 2. 静态配置结构
30: 
31: 在 `video_engine.c` 中定义了静态配置 `camera_parameters`，基于编译时的 CONFIG 宏自动配置：
32: 
33: ```c
34: static camera_parameters_t camera_parameters = {
35:     // Camera ID: 0 = DVP, 1 = UVC
36:     .id = 0,  // 基于 CONFIG_VIDEO_ENGINE_USE_DVP_CAMERA
37:     
38:     // Resolution
39:     .width = CONFIG_VIDEO_ENGINE_RESOLUTION_WIDTH,
40:     .height = CONFIG_VIDEO_ENGINE_RESOLUTION_HEIGHT,
41:     
42:     // Format: 0 = MJPEG, 1 = H264, 2 = H265
43:     .format = 0/1,  // 基于 CONFIG_VIDEO_ENGINE_JPEG_FORMAT 或 CONFIG_VIDEO_ENGINE_H264_FORMAT
44:     
45:     .protocol = 0,  // 保留字段
46:     .rotate = 0,    // 旋转角度
47: };
48: ```
49: 
50: ### 3. 核心函数
51: 
52: #### video_engine_init()
53: 
54: 初始化并启动视频引擎（一步完成所有工作）：
55: 
56: ```c
57: int video_engine_init(void)
58: {
59:     // 1. 检查是否已初始化
60:     // 2. 分配上下文内存
61:     // 3. 初始化帧队列
62:     // 4. 自动调用 video_engine_start()
63:     // 5. 返回结果
64: }
65: ```
66: 
67: #### video_engine_start()
68: 
69: 启动视频引擎（打开摄像头和启动传输任务）：
70: 
71: ```c
72: int video_engine_start(void)
73: {
74:     // 1. 检查上下文有效性
75:     // 2. 检查是否已启动
76:     // 3. 使用 camera_parameters 打开摄像头
77:     // 4. 启动视频传输任务
78:     // 5. 设置 is_started = true
79:     // 6. 返回结果
80: }
81: ```
82: 
83: #### video_engine_stop()
84: 
85: 停止视频引擎（关闭摄像头和传输任务）：
86: 
87: ```c
88: int video_engine_stop(void)
89: {
90:     // 1. 检查是否已启动
91:     // 2. 停止视频传输任务
92:     // 3. 关闭摄像头
93:     // 4. 设置 is_started = false
94:     // 5. 返回结果
95: }
96: ```
97: 
98: #### video_engine_deinit()
99: 
100: 完全清理视频引擎资源：
101: 
102: ```c
103: int video_engine_deinit(void)
104: {
105:     // 1. 调用 video_engine_stop()
106:     // 2. 清理帧队列
107:     // 3. 释放上下文内存
108:     // 4. 返回结果
109: }
110: ```
111: 
112: #### video_engine_is_running()
113: 
114: 检查视频引擎运行状态：
115: 
116: ```c
117: bool video_engine_is_running(void)
118: {
119:     if (g_video_engine_ctx == NULL) {
120:         return false;
121:     }
122:     return g_video_engine_ctx->is_started;
123: }
124: ```
125: 
126: ## 📊 完整调用流程
127: 
128: ```
129: 应用程序调用 video_engine_init()
130:     ↓
131: 检查是否已初始化
132:     ↓
133: 分配 g_video_engine_ctx 内存
134:     ↓
135: 初始化 frame_queue (所有格式：MJPEG, H264, YUV)
136:     ↓
137: 调用 video_engine_start()
138:     ↓
139:     ├─ 检查是否已启动（防止重复）
140:     ├─ 打开摄像头 (video_engine_camera_turn_on)
141:     │    ├─ 参数验证
142:     │    ├─ 配置 DVP (bk_dvp_config_t)
143:     │    ├─ 创建摄像头控制器
144:     │    └─ 打开摄像头
145:     ├─ 启动传输任务 (video_engine_transfer_start)
146:     │    ├─ 创建传输任务线程
147:     │    └─ 设置 transfer_task_running = true
148:     └─ 设置 is_started = true
149:     ↓
150: 初始化完成，返回 BK_OK
151: ```
152: 
153: ## ⚙️ 配置宏
154: 
155: 在项目配置文件 `Kconfig` 或 `sdkconfig.h` 中定义：
156: 
157: ```c
158: // 摄像头类型（二选一）
159: #define CONFIG_VIDEO_ENGINE_USE_DVP_CAMERA 1
160: // #define CONFIG_VIDEO_ENGINE_USE_UVC_CAMERA 1
161: 
162: // 分辨率
163: #define CONFIG_VIDEO_ENGINE_RESOLUTION_WIDTH 640
164: #define CONFIG_VIDEO_ENGINE_RESOLUTION_HEIGHT 480
165: 
166: // 编码格式（二选一）
167: #define CONFIG_VIDEO_ENGINE_JPEG_FORMAT 1
168: // #define CONFIG_VIDEO_ENGINE_H264_FORMAT 1
169: ```
170: 
171: ## 📖 使用示例
172: 
173: ### 场景 1: 标准使用流程（推荐）
174: 
175: 这是最简单、最推荐的使用方式：
176: 
177: ```c
178: #include "video_engine.h"
179: 
180: int main(void)
181: {
182:     // 1. 初始化视频引擎（自动配置并启动）
183:     int ret = video_engine_init();
184:     if (ret != BK_OK) {
185:         printf("Video engine init failed: %d\n", ret);
186:         return -1;
187:     }
188:     
189:     printf("Video engine started successfully\n");
190:     
191:     // 2. 检查运行状态
192:     if (video_engine_is_running()) {
193:         printf("Video engine is running\n");
194:     }
195:     
196:     // ... 应用程序运行 ...
197:     
198:     // 3. 清理资源
199:     video_engine_deinit();
200:     
201:     return 0;
202: }
203: ```
204: 
205: ### 场景 2: 完整生命周期管理
206: 
207: 如果需要更精细的控制：
208: 
209: ```c
210: #include "video_engine.h"
211: 
212: int main(void)
213: {
214:     int ret;
215:     
216:     // 1. 初始化（包括自动启动）
217:     ret = video_engine_init();
218:     if (ret != BK_OK) {
219:         printf("Init failed\n");
220:         return -1;
221:     }
222:     
223:     // 2. 应用运行...
224:     // ...
225:     
226:     // 3. 需要暂停时，停止视频引擎
227:     ret = video_engine_stop();
228:     if (ret != BK_OK) {
229:         printf("Stop failed\n");
230:     }
231:     
232:     // 4. 需要时，重新启动
233:     ret = video_engine_start();
234:     if (ret != BK_OK) {
235:         printf("Restart failed\n");
236:     }
237:     
238:     // 5. 程序退出前，完全清理
239:     video_engine_deinit();
240:     
241:     return 0;
242: }
243: ```
244: 
245: ### 场景 3: 状态检查
246: 
247: 在运行过程中检查视频引擎状态：
248: 
249: ```c
250: #include "video_engine.h"
251: 
252: void check_video_status(void)
253: {
254:     if (video_engine_is_running()) {
255:         printf("Video engine is running\n");
256:         // 执行需要视频的操作
257:     } else {
258:         printf("Video engine is not running\n");
259:         // 可以选择启动它
260:         int ret = video_engine_start();
261:         if (ret != BK_OK) {
262:             printf("Failed to start video engine\n");
263:         }
264:     }
265: }
266: ```
267: 
268: ### 场景 4: 错误处理示例
269: 
270: 完整的错误处理流程：
271: 
272: ```c
273: #include "video_engine.h"
274: 
275: int initialize_video_system(void)
276: {
277:     int ret;
278:     
279:     // 初始化视频引擎
280:     ret = video_engine_init();
281:     if (ret != BK_OK) {
282:         printf("ERROR: Failed to initialize video engine, ret=%d\n", ret);
283:         
284:         // 尝试清理可能的残留资源
285:         video_engine_deinit();
286:         return -1;
287:     }
288:     
289:     // 验证初始化成功
290:     if (!video_engine_is_running()) {
291:         printf("ERROR: Video engine initialized but not running\n");
292:         video_engine_deinit();
293:         return -1;
294:     }
295:     
296:     printf("Video system initialized successfully\n");
297:     return 0;
298: }
299: ```
300: 
301: ## 💾 内存占用分析
302: 
303: | 组件 | 内存占用 | 位置 | 说明 |
304: |------|---------|------|------|
305: | `video_engine_ctx_t` | ~24 B | Heap | 引擎上下文结构 |
306: | `camera_parameters` | ~12 B | .bss | 静态摄像头配置 |
307: | 传输任务栈 | 4 KB | Heap | 视频传输任务栈 |
308: | 帧缓冲队列 | 动态 | Heap | 根据格式分配 |
309: | - MJPEG 帧 | ~60-200 KB | Heap | 4个帧缓冲 |
310: | - H264 帧 | ~50-150 KB | Heap | 6个帧缓冲 |
311: | - YUV 帧 | ~300 KB-1.8 MB | Heap | 3个帧缓冲 |
312: 
313: **堆内存总计：** ~4-6 KB（不含帧缓冲） + 帧缓冲大小
314: 
315: ## ✨ 设计优势
316: 
317: 1. **简洁易用** - 一个函数完成初始化和启动
318: 2. **自动配置** - 基于 CONFIG 宏，编译时确定
319: 3. **状态管理** - `is_started` 标志防止重复操作
320: 4. **完整生命周期** - init → start → stop → deinit
321: 5. **错误处理** - 每步都有检查和回滚机制
322: 6. **资源安全** - 防止内存泄漏和野指针
323: 7. **并发安全** - 传输任务安全退出机制
324: 8. **API 一致性** - 与 audio_engine 保持一致
325: 
326: ## ⚠️ 注意事项
327: 
328: ### 1. 初始化要求
329: 
330: - ✅ **必须先调用** `video_engine_init()`，它会自动调用 `video_engine_start()`
331: - ✅ **不需要手动调用** `video_engine_start()`（除非停止后需要重启）
332: - ❌ **避免重复初始化**，`video_engine_init()` 会检查并返回已初始化状态
333: 
334: ### 2. 配置宏要求
335: 
336: 确保在 `Kconfig` 或 `sdkconfig.h` 中正确定义：
337: 
338: ```c
339: CONFIG_VIDEO_ENGINE_USE_DVP_CAMERA      // 摄像头类型
340: CONFIG_VIDEO_ENGINE_RESOLUTION_WIDTH    // 分辨率宽度
341: CONFIG_VIDEO_ENGINE_RESOLUTION_HEIGHT   // 分辨率高度
342: CONFIG_VIDEO_ENGINE_JPEG_FORMAT         // JPEG 格式
343: // 或
344: CONFIG_VIDEO_ENGINE_H264_FORMAT         // H264 格式
345: ```
346: 
347: ### 3. 调用顺序
348: 
349: ```c
350: // ✅ 正确顺序
351: video_engine_init();           // 初始化（包含启动）
352: video_engine_is_running();     // 检查状态
353: // ... 使用 ...
354: video_engine_deinit();         // 清理
355: 
356: // ❌ 错误示例 1：重复初始化
357: video_engine_init();
358: video_engine_init();           // 错误：已初始化
359: 
360: // ❌ 错误示例 2：未初始化就启动
361: video_engine_start();          // 错误：上下文为 NULL
362: 
363: // ❌ 错误示例 3：未清理就退出
364: video_engine_init();
365: // ... 使用 ...
366: exit(0);                       // 错误：资源泄漏
367: ```
368: 
369: ### 4. 线程安全
370: 
371: - ⚠️ API 函数**不是线程安全**的，多线程调用需要加锁
372: - ✅ 传输任务内部使用队列，任务间通信是安全的
373: 
374: ### 5. 错误处理
375: 
376: ```c
377: int ret = video_engine_init();
378: if (ret != BK_OK) {
379:     // 初始化失败，内部已经清理资源
380:     // 可以安全地再次尝试初始化
381:     LOGE("Init failed, ret=%d\n", ret);
382: }
383: 
384: // stop 和 deinit 会尽力清理，即使部分失败
385: video_engine_deinit();  // 总是调用以防万一
386: ```
387: 
388: ## 🔍 调试支持
389: 
390: ### 日志输出
391: 
392: 模块使用分级日志，可通过 TAG 过滤：
393: 
394: ```bash
395: # 过滤视频引擎日志
396: TAG=video_engine
397: 
398: # 关键日志示例
399: LOGI: video_engine_init: Video engine initialized successfully
400: LOGI: video_engine_start: Starting video engine (id:0, 640x480, format:1)
401: LOGI: video_engine_stop: Video engine stopped successfully
402: LOGE: video_engine_start: video_engine_camera_turn_on failed, ret=-1
403: ```
404: 
405: ### 状态检查
406: 
407: ```c
408: // 运行时检查引擎状态
409: if (video_engine_is_running()) {
410:     printf("Video engine is active\n");
411: } else {
412:     printf("Video engine is inactive\n");
413: }
414: ```
415: 
416: ### 常见问题排查
417: 
418: | 问题 | 可能原因 | 解决方法 |
419: |-----|---------|---------|
420: | `init` 失败 | 内存不足 | 检查堆内存，减少帧缓冲数量 |
421: | `start` 失败 | 摄像头打开失败 | 检查硬件连接和 GPIO 配置 |
422: | `stop` 部分失败 | 任务未正常退出 | 检查传输任务是否卡住 |
423: | 帧队列满 | 处理速度慢 | 优化网络发送或增加队列 |

1: # Network Transfer Module
2: 
3: ## 概述
4: 
5: network_transfer模块提供了统一的音频网络传输接口，支持多种RTC后端（Volc RTC、Agora RTC等）。
6: 
7: ## 主要特性
8: 
9: - 统一的音频发送接口
10: - 支持多种RTC后端（火山引擎RTC、声网RTC）
11: - 模块化的设计，易于扩展
12: - 完整的错误处理和日志
13: - 支持音频数据接收和编码器类型获取
14: 
15: ## 接口说明
16: 
17: ### 头文件
18: ```c
19: #include "network_transfer.h"
20: ```
21: 
22: ### 主要函数
23: 
24: #### 初始化/反初始化
25: ```c
26: int ntwk_trans_init(void);
27: int ntwk_trans_deinit(void);
28: ```
29: 
30: #### 启动/停止
31: ```c
32: int ntwk_trans_start(void *user_data);
33: int ntwk_trans_stop(void *user_data);
34: ```
35: 
36: #### 音频数据发送
37: ```c
38: int ntwk_trans_send_audio(const uint8_t *data, size_t size, audio_enc_type_t audio_type);
39: ```
40: 
41: #### 音频数据接收
42: ```c
43: int ntwk_trans_recv_audio(const uint8_t *data, size_t size);
44: ```
45: 
46: #### 网络类型管理
47: ```c
48: network_type_t ntwk_trans_get_network_type(void);
49: ```
50: 
51: #### 编码器类型获取
52: ```c
53: audio_enc_type_t ntwk_trans_get_audio_encoder_type(void);
54: ```
55: 
56: ## 使用示例
57: 
58: ### 基本使用
59: ```c
60: #include "network_transfer.h"
61: 
62: int main() {
63:     // 初始化网络传输模块
64:     if (ntwk_trans_init() != 0) {
65:         printf("Network transfer init failed\n");
66:         return -1;
67:     }
68:     
69:     // 启动网络传输
70:     if (ntwk_trans_start(NULL) != 0) {
71:         printf("Network transfer start failed\n");
72:         return -1;
73:     }
74:     
75:     // 获取网络类型
76:     network_type_t network_type = ntwk_trans_get_network_type();
77:     printf("Current network type: %d\n", network_type);
78:     
79:     // 获取音频编码器类型
80:     audio_enc_type_t encoder_type = ntwk_trans_get_audio_encoder_type();
81:     printf("Audio encoder type: %d\n", encoder_type);
82:     
83:     // 发送音频数据
84:     uint8_t audio_data[1024];
85:     // ... 填充音频数据
86:     if (ntwk_trans_send_audio(audio_data, sizeof(audio_data), encoder_type) != 0) {
87:         printf("Send audio failed\n");
88:     }
89:     
90:     // 停止网络传输
91:     if (ntwk_trans_stop(NULL) != 0) {
92:         printf("Network transfer stop failed\n");
93:     }
94:     
95:     // 反初始化
96:     if (ntwk_trans_deinit() != 0) {
97:         printf("Network transfer deinit failed\n");
98:     }
99:     
100:     return 0;
101: }
102: ```
103: 
104: ## 配置选项
105: 
106: 在项目的Kconfig中需要配置：

1: # Agora RTC Integration for AI SO Main Project
2: 
3: ## 概述
4: 
5: 本目录包含将 Agora RTC SDK 集成到 `ai_so_main` 工程的移植代码。此移植参考了 `volc_rtc` 的架构模式，提供统一的网络传输接口。
6: 
7: ## 架构设计
8: 
9: ```
10: agora_rtc/
11: ├── agora_config.h           # Agora SDK 配置（App ID, Token等）
12: ├── agora_rtc_engine.h       # RTC引擎接口定义
13: ├── agora_rtc_engine.c       # RTC引擎核心实现
14: ├── bk_agora_api.h           # 顶层公共API接口
15: ├── bk_agora_api.c           # 顶层API实现（对接network_transfer）
16: └── README.md                # 本文档
17: ```
18: 
19: ### 架构层次
20: 
21: ```
22: Application Layer (app_main.c)
23:         ↓
24: Network Transfer Layer (network_transfer.c)
25:         ↓
26: Agora API Layer (bk_agora_api.c)
27:         ↓
28: Agora Engine Layer (agora_rtc_engine.c)
29:         ↓
30: Agora RTC SDK (agora_rtc_api.h)
31: ```
32: 
33: ## 主要组件说明
34: 
35: ### 1. agora_config.h
36: 包含 Agora RTC SDK 的配置参数：
37: - **CONFIG_AGORA_APP_ID**: Agora应用ID（必须配置）
38: - **CONFIG_AGORA_TOKEN**: Token（生产环境必须启用）
39: - **CONFIG_CHANNEL_NAME**: 默认频道名称
40: - **CONFIG_MASTER_SERVER_URL**: Agora服务器地址
41: - **CONFIG_PRODUCT_KEY**: 设备管理平台产品密钥
42: 
43: ### 2. agora_rtc_engine.c
44: RTC引擎核心实现：
45: - **__agora_rtc_create()**: 创建并初始化RTC实例
46: - **__agora_rtc_start()**: 启动RTC并加入频道
47: - **__agora_rtc_stop()**: 停止RTC并离开频道
48: - **__agora_rtc_destroy()**: 销毁RTC实例
49: - **事件回调**: 处理连接状态、用户加入/离开等事件
50: 
51: ### 3. bk_agora_api.c
52: 应用层API实现：
53: - **bk_agora_rtc_audio_data_send()**: 发送音频数据
54: - **bk_agora_rtc_video_data_send()**: 发送视频数据（支持H.264/H.265/JPEG）
55: - **bk_agora_start()**: 启动Agora服务
56: - **bk_agora_stop()**: 停止Agora服务
57: - **帧率控制**: 默认500ms发送一次视频I帧
58: 
59: ## 配置方法
60: 
61: ### 1. Kconfig 配置
62: 
63: 在 `components/network_transfer/Kconfig` 中启用：
64: 
65: ```kconfig
66: config BK_AGORA_RTC
67:     bool "Enable Agora RTC for network transfer"
68:     default n
69: ```
70: 
71: 使用 `menuconfig` 启用：
72: ```bash
73: make menuconfig
74: # 导航到: net_transfer -> Enable Agora RTC for network transfer
75: ```
76: 
77: ### 2. 修改 agora_config.h
78: 
79: ```c
80: // 必须配置您自己的 App ID
81: #define CONFIG_AGORA_APP_ID "your_agora_app_id_here"
82: 
83: // 生产环境建议启用 Token
84: #define CONFIG_AGORA_TOKEN "your_token_here"
85: 
86: // 可选：修改频道名称
87: #define CONFIG_CHANNEL_NAME "your_channel_name"
88: ```
89: 
90: ### 3. 配置 Room Info
91: 
92: 在应用代码中设置房间信息：
93: 
94: ```c
95: #include "bk_agora_api.h"
96: 
97: extern agora_rtc_room_info_t *agora_room_info;
98: 
99: // 初始化房间信息
100: agora_room_info = (agora_rtc_room_info_t *)psram_malloc(sizeof(agora_rtc_room_info_t));
101: os_strcpy(agora_room_info->app_id, CONFIG_AGORA_APP_ID);
102: os_strcpy(agora_room_info->channel_name, "test_channel");
103: agora_room_info->uid_int = 12345;
104: os_strcpy(agora_room_info->token, CONFIG_AGORA_TOKEN);
105: ```
106: 
107: ## 使用示例
108: 
109: ### 1. 基本初始化流程
110: 
111: ```c
112: #include "network_transfer.h"
113: 
114: // 1. 初始化网络传输模块
115: ntwk_trans_init();
116: 
117: // 2. 启动 RTC（Agora 会自动启动）
118: ntwk_trans_start(NULL);
119: 
120: // 3. 网络传输模块会自动调用 Agora RTC 的相关接口
121: ```
122: 
123: ### 2. 发送音频数据
124: 
125: ```c
126: // 音频数据会通过 network_transfer 自动路由到 Agora
127: ntwk_trans_send_audio(audio_data, audio_len, AUDIO_ENC_TYPE_G711A);
128: ```
129: 
130: ### 3. 发送视频数据
131: 
132: ```c
133: // 视频数据会通过 network_transfer 自动路由到 Agora
134: frame_buffer_t *frame = ...; // 从 video_engine 获取
135: ntwk_trans_send_video(frame);
136: ```
137: 
138: ### 4. 停止和清理
139: 
140: ```c
141: // 停止网络传输
142: ntwk_trans_stop(NULL);
143: 
144: // 反初始化
145: ntwk_trans_deinit();
146: ```
147: 
148: ## 特性说明
149: 
150: ### 视频传输特性
151: 
152: 1. **I帧过滤**: 仅发送H.264 I帧以节省带宽
153: 2. **帧率控制**: 默认500ms发送一次（2 FPS），可通过 `VIDEO_FRAME_INTERVAL` 调整
154: 3. **格式支持**: 
155:    - H.264 (VIDEO_DATA_TYPE_H264)
156:    - H.265 (VIDEO_DATA_TYPE_H265)
157:    - JPEG (VIDEO_DATA_TYPE_GENERIC_JPEG)
158: 
159: ### 音频传输特性
160: 
161: 1. **编码格式支持**:
162:    - G.711A (PCMA)
163:    - G.711U (PCMU)
164:    - G.722
165:    - OPUS
166:    - PCM
167: 
168: 2. **自动编码映射**: 从 `audio_enc_type_t` 到 Agora `audio_data_type_e` 的自动转换
169: 
170: ### 日志控制
171: 
172: 关键日志已默认禁用以减少屏幕刷屏：
173: - 连接失败日志（仅在未连接时）
174: - 视频/音频发送成功日志
175: - 用户静音/取消静音事件
176: 
177: ## 与 volc_rtc 的对比
178: 
179: | 特性 | volc_rtc | agora_rtc |
180: |------|----------|-----------|
181: | 架构 | 火山引擎RTC | 声网Agora RTC |
182: | 配置方式 | volc_config.h | agora_config.h |
183: | API接口 | bk_byte_* | bk_agora_* |
184: | 视频I帧过滤 | ✓ | ✓ |
185: | 帧率控制 | ✓ (500ms) | ✓ (500ms) |
186: | 音频编码 | 多种 | 多种 |
187: | Agent管理 | ✓ | ✓ (可扩展) |
188: 
189: ## 注意事项
190: 
191: 1. **App ID 配置**: 必须在 `agora_config.h` 中配置有效的 Agora App ID
192: 2. **Token 安全**: 生产环境必须启用 Token 认证
193: 3. **内存管理**: Room info 使用 `psram_malloc` 分配，注意内存释放
194: 4. **线程安全**: Agora 主线程优先级为 4，栈大小 6KB
195: 5. **WiFi 连接**: 确保设备已连接WiFi后再启动 Agora RTC
196: 
197: ## 调试建议
198: 
199: ### 1. 启用详细日志
200: 
201: 在 `agora_rtc_config` 中设置：
202: ```c
203: agora_rtc_config.log_disable = false; // 启用 SDK 日志
204: ```
205: 
206: ### 2. 检查连接状态
207: 
208: ```c
209: extern bool g_connected_flag;
210: extern bool g_agent_offline;
211: 
212: if (!g_connected_flag) {
213:     LOGE("Agora RTC not connected\n");
214: }
215: ```
216: 
217: ### 3. 查看事件消息
218: 
219: 事件消息在 `bk_agora_user_notify_msg_handle()` 中处理，可添加日志跟踪：
220: - JOIN_CHANNEL_SUCCESS
221: - USER_JOINED
222: - CONNECTION_LOST
223: - etc.
224: 
225: ## 未来扩展
226: 
227: 1. **Agent Engine**: 参考 `volc_agent_engine.c` 添加设备管理功能
228: 2. **数据流控制**: 添加视频流动态码率调整
229: 3. **多路流支持**: 支持多用户视频会议
230: 4. **屏幕共享**: 添加屏幕共享功能
231: 
232: ## 参考文档
233: 
234: - [Agora RTC SDK 文档](https://docs.agora.io/cn)
235: - [Network Transfer 架构](../README_CN.md)
236: - [VolcEngineRTC 参考实现](../volc_rtc/)
237:

1: # JPEG Decoding Example Project
2: 
3: * [中文](./README_CN.md)
4: 
5: ## 1. Project Overview
6: 
7: This project is a JPEG decoding test module designed to test JPEG decoding functionality on the Beken platform. It provides a Command Line Interface (CLI) that supports both hardware decoding and software decoding, and also supports running the software decoder on DTCM (which improves decoding speed).
8: 
9: * For detailed information about JPEG decoding, please refer to:
10: 
11:   - [JPEG Decoding Overview](../../../developer-guide/video_codec/jpeg_decoding.html)
12: 
13:   - [JPEG Hardware Decoding Guide](../../../developer-guide/video_codec/jpeg_decoding_hw.html)
14: 
15:   - [JPEG Software Decoding Guide](../../../developer-guide/video_codec/jpeg_decoding_sw.html)
16: 
17: * For API reference, please refer to:
18: 
19:   - [JPEG Hardware Decoder API](../../../api-reference/multimedia/bk_jpegdec_hw.html)
20: 
21:   - [JPEG Software Decoder API](../../../api-reference/multimedia/bk_jpegdec_sw.html)
22: 
23: ### 1.1 Test Environment
24: 
25:    * Hardware configuration:
26:       * Core board, **BK7258_QFN88_9X9_V3.2**
27:       * PSRAM 8M/16M
28:    * Supports MJPEG hardware encoding/decoding
29:       * YUV422
30:    * Supports MJPEG software decoding
31:       * YUV420, YUV444, YUV400, YUV422
32:       * When outputting YUYV format, rotation angles (0°, 90°, 180°, 270°) can be configured
33: 
34: .. warning::
35:     Please use reference peripherals for familiarization and learning of the demo project. If peripheral specifications are different, the code may need to be reconfigured.
36: 
37: ## 2. Directory Structure
38: 
39: The project adopts an AP-CP dual-core architecture, with the main source code located in the AP directory. The project structure is as follows:
40: 
41: ```
42: jpeg_decode_example/

49: ├── ap/                   # AP-side code
50: │   ├── CMakeLists.txt    # AP-side CMake build file
51: │   ├── Kconfig.projbuild # Kconfig configuration
52: │   ├── ap_main.c         # AP main entry file
53: │   ├── config/           # AP configuration directory
54: │   └── jpeg_decode/      # JPEG decode implementation
55: │       ├── data/         # Test JPEG image data

67: ## 3. Feature Description
68: 
69: ### 3.1 Main Features
70: 
71: - Supports hardware JPEG decoding and software JPEG decoding
72: - Provides CLI for decoding tests
73: - Supports retrieving JPEG image dimension information
74: - Implements frame buffer management mechanism
75: - Offers regular and abnormal scenario decoding test functionality
76: - Supports hardware asynchronous decoding and burst mode testing
77: - Supports running software decoder on DTCM for faster performance
78: 
79: ### 3.2 Frame Buffer Management
80: 
81: The project implements a frame buffer management mechanism for efficiently managing image buffers during JPEG encoding and decoding:
82: 
83: - Supports three image formats: MJPEG, H264, and YUV
84: - Maintains separate free queues and ready queues for each format
85: - Provides interfaces for buffer allocation, retrieval, and release operations
86: 
87: ### 3.3 JPEG Decoding Process
88: 
89: 1. Initialize the JPEG decoder (hardware or software)
90: 2. Open the decoder
91: 3. Perform decoding operations:
92:    - Allocate input buffer and fill with JPEG data
93:    - Retrieve image dimension information
94:    - Configure input and output frame dimensions: Set the parsed image width and height to input and output frame structures
95:    - Allocate output buffer
96:    - Execute decoding (if rotation angle is configured, output frame width and height will be reconfigured internally based on the rotation angle during decoding)
97:    - Release buffers
98: 4. Close the decoder
99: 5. Delete the decoder instance
100:

261:

263:   * **420_864_480** : YUV420 format JPEG image with 864x480 resolution
264:   * **422_865_480** : YUV422 format JPEG image with 865x480 resolution
265:   * **422_864_479** : YUV422 format JPEG image with 864x479 resolution
266:   * **420_865_480** : YUV420 format JPEG image with 865x480 resolution
267:   * **420_864_479** : YUV420 format JPEG image with 864x479 resolution
268: 
269: Hardware decoding only supports decoding YUV422 format images; YUV420 format images will fail to decode.
270: 
271: Hardware decoding requires images to have width as a multiple of 16 and height as a multiple of 8, otherwise decoding will fail.
272: 
273: Software decoding supports decoding both YUV420 and YUV422 format images.
274: 
275: Software decoding requires images to have width as a multiple of 2, with no restrictions on height, otherwise decoding will fail.

702: ## 7. Configuration Options
703: 
704: ### 7.1 Thread Stack Size Configuration
705: 
706: The decoder thread stack sizes can be configured via Kconfig:
707: 
708: - **CONFIG_HW_JPEG_DECODE_TASK_STACK_SIZE**: Thread stack size for hardware JPEG decode task (bytes)
709:   - Default value: 1024 bytes
710:   - Configuration path: menuconfig -> JPEG Decoder -> Hardware JPEG decode task stack size
711: 
712: - **CONFIG_HW_JPEG_DECODE_OPT_TASK_STACK_SIZE**: Thread stack size for hardware optimized JPEG decode task (bytes)
713:   - Default value: 2048 bytes
714:   - Configuration path: menuconfig -> JPEG Decoder -> Hardware optimized JPEG decode task stack size
715: 
716: - **CONFIG_SW_JPEG_DECODE_TASK_STACK_SIZE**: Thread stack size for software JPEG decode task (bytes)
717:   - Default value: 1024 bytes
718:   - Configuration path: menuconfig -> JPEG Decoder -> Software JPEG decode task stack size
719: 
720: Note: Adjust the stack size based on actual decoding scenarios and memory resources; increase this value if stack overflow occurs.
721: 
722: ### 7.2 Hardware Optimized Decoder Configuration
723: 
724: The hardware optimized decoder provides the following configuration options:
725: 
726: - **is_pingpong**: Whether to enable Ping-Pong buffering mode
727:   - true: Enable dual buffering for improved parallelism
728:   - false: Use single buffering to reduce memory usage
729: 
730: - **copy_method**: Data copy method
731:   - JPEG_DECODE_OPT_COPY_METHOD_MEMCPY: Use os_memcpy for data transfer
732:   - JPEG_DECODE_OPT_COPY_METHOD_DMA: Use DMA for data transfer (currently falls back to MEMCPY)
733: 
734: - **sram_buffer**: SRAM buffer pointer
735:   - NULL: Automatically allocate SRAM buffer
736:   - Non-NULL: Use specified SRAM buffer
737: 
738: - **lines_per_block**: Number of lines to decode per block
739:   - Must be 8 or 16
740:   - Recommended value: 16 (suitable for most scenarios)
741: 
742: - **image_max_width**: Maximum image width
743:   - Used to calculate SRAM buffer size
744:   - Default value: 864
745: 
746: ## 8. Notes
747: 
748: 1. Ensure the decoder is properly initialized before use
749: 2. Remember to release related resources after decoding operations are completed
750: 3. Hardware decoding and software decoding have different capabilities; choose the appropriate decoding method based on actual needs:
751:    - Hardware decoding only supports YUV422 format images, and requires image width to be a multiple of 16 and height to be a multiple of 8
752:    - Hardware optimized decoding has the same format limitations as hardware decoding, but uses SRAM buffering optimization for lower peak memory usage
753:    - Software decoding supports both YUV420 and YUV422 format images, and requires image width to be a multiple of 2, with no restrictions on height
754: 4. Software decoders running on DTCM typically provide faster decoding speeds than regular software decoders
755: 5. Frame buffer resources are limited; avoid occupying too many buffers simultaneously
756: 6. In the input frame, the length within the structure needs to be set to the actual valid data length, and in the output frame, the size within the structure needs to be set to the maximum storable size;
757:    A length of 0 for the input frame or a size of 0 for the output frame will result in decoding errors;
758: 7. **Image Dimension and Rotation Processing Notes**:
759: 
760:    - After retrieving JPEG image information, the decoder sets the parsed width and height to the input and output frame structures
761:    - For software decoding, if a rotation angle is configured, the output frame's width and height will be reconfigured internally based on the rotation angle:
762: 
763:      * For 90 or 270 degree rotation: Output frame width and height are swapped (width = original height, height = original width)
764:      * For 0 or 180 degree rotation: Output frame maintains original width and height
765: 
766:    - Hardware decoding and hardware optimized decoding do not support rotation; output frame dimensions remain consistent with input frame dimensions
767: 
768: 8. **Hardware Optimized Decoder Usage Recommendations**:
769:    - Recommended for memory-constrained application scenarios
770:    - Ping-Pong mode is suitable for high-throughput scenarios
771:    - Single buffer mode is suitable for memory-constrained scenarios
772:    - lines_per_block is recommended to be set to 16 for optimal performance
773:    - SRAM buffer can be reused to avoid frequent allocation and deallocation
774: 
775: 9. **Callback Function Usage Notes**:
776:    - Blocking operations (such as long waits, sleep, etc.) are not recommended in callback functions to avoid impacting decoding performance and system responsiveness
777:    - It is recommended to perform only lightweight operations in callback functions, such as setting flags, sending messages/semaphores, etc., and move time-consuming operations to other tasks

68: ## 3. 功能说明

697: 
698: ## 7. 配置选项
699: 
700: ### 7.1 线程栈大小配置
701: 
702: 解码器的线程栈大小可以通过Kconfig进行配置：
703: 
704: - **CONFIG_HW_JPEG_DECODE_TASK_STACK_SIZE**: 硬件JPEG解码任务的线程栈大小（字节）
705:   - 默认值：1024 字节
706:   - 配置路径：menuconfig -> JPEG Decoder -> Hardware JPEG decode task stack size
707: 
708: - **CONFIG_HW_JPEG_DECODE_OPT_TASK_STACK_SIZE**: 硬件优化JPEG解码任务的线程栈大小（字节）
709:   - 默认值：2048 字节
710:   - 配置路径：menuconfig -> JPEG Decoder -> Hardware optimized JPEG decode task stack size
711: 
712: - **CONFIG_SW_JPEG_DECODE_TASK_STACK_SIZE**: 软件JPEG解码任务的线程栈大小（字节）
713:   - 默认值：1024 字节
714:   - 配置路径：menuconfig -> JPEG Decoder -> Software JPEG decode task stack size
715: 
716: 说明：根据实际解码场景和内存资源调整栈大小，如遇到栈溢出可适当增大此值。
717: 
718: ### 7.2 硬件优化解码器配置
719: 
720: 硬件优化解码器提供了以下配置选项：
721: 
722: - **is_pingpong**: 是否启用Ping-Pong缓冲模式
723:   - true: 启用双缓冲，提高并行度
724:   - false: 使用单缓冲，降低内存占用
725: 
726: - **copy_method**: 数据拷贝方法
727:   - JPEG_DECODE_OPT_COPY_METHOD_MEMCPY: 使用os_memcpy进行数据拷贝
728:   - JPEG_DECODE_OPT_COPY_METHOD_DMA: 使用DMA进行数据拷贝（当前版本会回退到MEMCPY）
729: 
730: - **sram_buffer**: SRAM缓冲区指针
731:   - NULL: 自动分配SRAM缓冲区
732:   - 非NULL: 使用指定的SRAM缓冲区
733: 
734: - **lines_per_block**: 每次解码的行数
735:   - 必须为8或16
736:   - 建议值：16（适用于大多数场景）
737: 
738: - **image_max_width**: 图像最大宽度
739:   - 用于计算SRAM缓冲区大小
740:   - 默认值：864
741: 
742: ## 8. 注意事项
743: 
744: 1. 确保在使用解码器前正确初始化
745: 2. 解码操作完成后，记得释放相关资源
746: 3. 硬件解码和软件解码功能有所差异，请根据实际需求选择合适的解码方式：
747:    - 硬件解码仅支持YUV422格式图像,且需要图像宽度为16的倍数，高度为8的倍数
748:    - 硬件优化解码与硬件解码格式限制相同，但使用SRAM缓冲优化，内存峰值更低
749:    - 软件解码支持YUV420和YUV422格式图像，且需要图像宽度为2的倍数，高度无限制
750: 4. 在DTCM上运行的软件解码器通常比普通软件解码器提供更快的解码速度
751: 5. 帧缓冲资源有限，请避免同时占用过多缓冲区
752: 6. 输入frame中，结构体内的length需要设置为实有效数据的长度，输出frame中，结构体内的size需要设置为最大的可存放的大小；
753:    输入frame的length为0或输出frame的size为0均会出现解码错误；
754: 7. **图像尺寸和旋转处理说明**：
755: 
756:    - 解码器在获取JPEG图像信息后，会将解析得到的宽度和高度设置到输入帧和输出帧结构中
757:    - 对于软件解码，如果配置了旋转角度，输出帧的宽度和高度会在解码内部根据旋转角度重新配置：
758: 
759:      * 旋转90度或270度时：输出帧的宽度和高度会互换（width = 原height，height = 原width）
760:      * 旋转0度或180度时：输出帧保持原始的宽度和高度
761: 
762:    - 硬件解码和硬件优化解码不支持旋转功能，输出帧尺寸与输入帧尺寸保持一致
763: 
764: 8. **硬件优化解码器使用建议**：
765:    - 对于内存受限的应用场景，推荐使用硬件优化解码器
766:    - Ping-Pong模式适用于需要高吞吐量的场景
767:    - 单缓冲模式适用于内存紧张的场景
768:    - lines_per_block建议设置为16以获得最佳性能
769:    - SRAM缓冲区可以复用，避免频繁分配和释放
770: 
771: 9. **回调函数使用注意事项**：
772:    - 回调函数中不建议执行阻塞操作（如长时间等待、sleep等），以避免影响解码性能和系统响应
773:    - 建议在回调函数中仅进行轻量级操作，如设置标志位、发送消息/信号量等，将耗时操作放到其他任务中执行

1: # Player Service Test Project
2: 
3: * [中文](./README_CN.md)

5: ## 1. Project Overview
6: This project is a player service test module designed to test the functionality of the bk_player_service component on the Beken platform. This module provides comprehensive audio playback link testing, including audio data sources, encoding/decoding, and audio output functions, and is configured and controlled through a command-line interface (CLI).
7: 
8: * For player service API reference, please see:
9: 
10:   - [Player Service API Reference](../../../api-reference/audio/player_service/index.html)
11: 
12: * For player service development guide, please see:
13: 
14:   - [Player Service Development Guide](../../../developer-guide/audio/player_service/index.html)
15: 
16: ## 2. Directory Structure
17: The project adopts an AP-CP dual-core architecture, with the main source code located in the AP directory. The project structure is as follows:
18: ```
19: player_service_example/
20: ├── .ci                             # CI configuration directory
21: ├── .gitignore                      # Git ignore file configuration
22: ├── CMakeLists.txt                  # Project-level CMake build file
23: ├── Makefile                        # Make build file
24: ├── README.md                       # English README
25: ├── README_CN.md                    # Chinese README
26: ├── ap/                             # AP core code directory
27: │   ├── CMakeLists.txt              # AP CMake build file
28: │   ├── ap_main.c                   # Main entry file, implementing CLI commands and test functions
29: │   ├── config/                     # AP configuration directory
30: │   │   └── bk7258_ap/              # BK7258 AP configuration
31: │   └── player_service_test/        # Player service test module directory
32: │       ├── cli_player_service.c    # Player service CLI command implementation
33: │       ├── cli_player_service.h    # Player service CLI command header file
34: │       └── prompt_tone_test.h      # Prompt tone test data header file
35: │   └── voice_service_test/         # Voice service test module directory
36: │       ├── cli_voice_service.c     # Voice service CLI command implementation
37: │       └── cli_voice_service.h     # Voice service CLI command header file
38: ├── cp/                             # CP core code directory
39: │   ├── CMakeLists.txt              # CP CMake build file
40: │   ├── cp_main.c                   # CP main file
41: │   ├── config/                     # CP configuration directory
42: │   │   └── bk7258/                 # BK7258 CP configuration
43: │   └── customer_msg/               # Customer message processing module
44: │       ├── customer_msg.c          # Customer message processing implementation
45: │       └── customer_msg.h          # Customer message processing header file
46: ├── partitions/                     # Partition configuration directory
47: │   └── bk7258/                     # BK7258 partition configuration
48: │       ├── auto_partitions.csv     # Automatic partition configuration
49: │       └── ram_regions.csv         # RAM region configuration
50: └── pj_config.mk                    # Project configuration file
51: ```

53: ## 3. Function Description
54: ### 3.1 Main Functions
55:    - **Audio Playback**: Default support for onboard speaker (onboard SPK) and UAC speaker
56:    - **Audio Source Support**: Support for two types of audio data sources: array and file system (vfs)
57:    - **Codec Support**: Multiple audio formats including MP3 and WAV
58: 
59: ### 3.3 Configuration Parameter Description
60: 
61: The player service supports two types of commands:
62:    - ``playback`` (Audio Playback): Test independent audio playback functionality
63:    - ``prompt_tone`` (Prompt Tone Playback): Test prompt tone insertion functionality during multiple audio playback
64: 
65: #### 3.3.1 Playback Command Parameters
66: 
67: 1. **Command Format**:
68:    ```
69:    player_service playback [cmd] [source_type] [info]
70:    ```
71: 
72: 2. **Parameter Description**:
73: 
74:    - ``[cmd]`` ：Command type
75:       - ``start`` ：Start playback
76:       - ``stop`` ：Stop playback
77: 
78:    - ``[source_type]`` ：Audio source type
79:       - ``array`` ：Array audio source, using built-in prompt tone data
80:       - ``vfs`` ：File system audio source, reading audio files from the file system
81: 
82:    - ``[info]`` ：Audio information
83:       - When ``source_type`` is ``array`` ， ``info`` is the array ID：
84:          - ``0`` ：ASR wake-up prompt tone (PCM format)
85:          - ``1`` ：Network configuration prompt tone (MP3 format)
86:          - ``2`` ：Low voltage prompt tone (WAV format)
87:       - When ``source_type`` is ``vfs`` ， ``info`` is the file path, for example ``/data/test.wav``
88: 
89: #### 3.3.2 Prompt Tone Command Parameters
90: 
91: 1. **Command Format**:
92:    ```
93:    player_service prompt_tone [cmd] [tone_id] [source_type] [info]
94:    ```
95: 
96: 2. **Parameter Description**:
97: 
98:    - ``[cmd]`` ：Command type
99:       - ``start`` ：Start playback
100:       - ``stop`` ：Stop playback
101: 
102:    - ``[tone_id]`` ：Prompt tone ID
103:       - ``0`` ：First prompt tone (ASR wake-up prompt tone)
104:       - ``1`` ：Second prompt tone (network configuration prompt tone)
105:       - ``2`` ：Third prompt tone (low voltage prompt tone)
106: 
107:    - ``[source_type]`` ：Audio source type
108:       - ``array`` ：Array audio source, using built-in prompt tone data
109:       - ``vfs`` ：File system audio source, reading audio files from the file system
110: 
111:    - ``[info]`` ：Audio information
112:       - When ``source_type`` is ``array`` ， ``info`` is the array ID：
113:          - ``0`` ：ASR wake-up prompt tone (PCM format)
114:          - ``1`` ：Network configuration prompt tone (MP3 format)
115:          - ``2`` ：Low voltage prompt tone (WAV format)
116:       - When ``source_type`` is ``vfs`` ， ``info`` is the file path, for example ``/data/test.wav``
117: 
118: ## 4. Compilation and Execution
119: ### 4.1 Compilation Method
120: Use the following command to compile the project:
121: 
122: .. code-block:: bash
123: 
124:    make bk7258 PROJECT=player_service_example
125: 
126: ### 4.2 Execution Method
127: After compilation, burn the generated firmware to the development board, and then use the following commands through the serial terminal to test the player service functions:
128: 
129: #### 4.2.1 Playback Command (Audio Playback)
130: **Basic Format**:
131: 
132: .. code-block:: bash
133: 
134:    player_service playback [cmd] [source_type] [info]
135: 
136: **Examples**:
137: 
138: .. code-block:: bash
139: 
140:    # Start playing ASR wake-up prompt tone
141:    player_service playback start array 0
142: 
143:    # Start playing an audio file from the file system
144:    player_service playback start vfs /sd0/test.wav
145: 
146:    # Stop playback
147:    player_service playback stop
148: 
149: #### 4.2.2 Prompt Tone Command (Prompt Tone Playback)
150: **Basic Format**:
151: 
152: .. code-block:: bash
153: 
154:    player_service prompt_tone [cmd] [tone_id] [source_type] [info]
155: 
156: **Examples**:
157: 
158: .. code-block:: bash
159: 
160:    # Start playing the first prompt tone (ASR wake-up prompt tone)
161:    player_service prompt_tone start 1 array 0
162: 
163:    # Start playing the second prompt tone (network configuration prompt tone)
164:    player_service prompt_tone start 2 array 1
165: 
166:    # Start playing an audio file from the file system as a prompt tone
167:    player_service prompt_tone start 1 vfs /sd0/test.wav
168: 
169:    # Stop prompt tone playback
170:    player_service prompt_tone stop 1
171: 
172: ## 5. Test Plan
173: Use speakers to test audio playback. The test procedure is as follows:
174: 
175: 1. Select an appropriate playback command (playback or prompt_tone)
176: 2. Configure the audio source type and information
177: 3. Listen to the speaker to check if the played audio can be heard
178: 4. Send a stop command to end playback
179: 
180: ## 6. Test Examples
181: 1. Playback command test - array audio playback
182: 
183: .. code-block:: bash
184: 
185:    Send the following test commands in sequence:
186:    # Start playing ASR wake-up prompt tone
187:    player_service playback start array 0
188: 
189:    # Stop playback
190:    player_service playback stop
191: 
192: 2. Playback command test - file audio playback
193: 
194: .. code-block:: bash
195: 
196:    Send the following test commands in sequence:
197:    # Start playing an audio file from the file system
198:    player_service playback start vfs /data/test.wav
199: 
200:    # Stop playback
201:    player_service playback stop
202: 
203: 3. Prompt Tone command test - interrupt array prompt tone
204: 
205: .. code-block:: bash
206: 
207:    Send the following test commands in sequence:
208:    # Start voice call function
209:    ap_cmd voice_service start onboard 8000 1 g711a g711a onboard 8000 0
210: 
211:    # Start interrupting prompt tone
212:    player_service prompt_tone start 1 array 0
213: 
214:    # Stop prompt tone playback
215:    player_service prompt_tone stop
216: 
217:    # Close voice call function
218:    ap_cmd voice_service stop onboard 8000 1 g711a g711a onboard 8000 0
219: 
220: 4. Prompt Tone command test - interrupt file prompt tone
221: 
222: .. code-block:: bash
223: 
224:    Send the following test commands in sequence:
225:    # Start voice call function
226:    ap_cmd voice_service start onboard 8000 1 g711a g711a onboard 8000 0
227: 
228:    # Start playing an audio file from the file system as a prompt tone
229:    player_service prompt_tone start 1 vfs /sd0/test.wav
230: 
231:    # Stop playback
232:    player_service prompt_tone stop 1
233: 
234:    # Close voice call function
235:    ap_cmd voice_service stop onboard 8000 1 g711a g711a onboard 8000 0
236: 
237: Successful command execution returns: ``CMDRSP:OK``
238: Failed command execution returns: ``CMDRSP:ERROR``
239: 
240: .. important::
241: 
242:    For information on using voice call function commands, please refer to: `Voice Service Example Project <../../../examples/projects/voice_service_example/index.html>`_

5: ## 1. 项目概述
6: 本项目是一个播放器服务测试模块，用于测试Beken平台上的bk_player_service组件功能。该模块提供了完整的音频播放链路测试，包括音频数据源、编解码、音频输出等功能，并通过命令行接口(CLI)进行配置和控制。
7:

1: # DMA2D Example
2: 
3: * [中文](./README_CN.md)
4: 
5: ## Overview
6: This example demonstrates the usage of the DMA2D (Direct Memory Access 2D) controller in the BK7258 platform. It provides functionality for 2D graphics operations such as filling regions with color, memory copying, pixel format conversion, and blending two image layers.
7: 
8: 
9: * For detailed information about DMA2D, please refer to:
10: 
11:   - [DMA2D Overview](../../../developer-guide/display/dma2d.html)
12: 
13: * For API reference, please refer to:
14: 
15:   - `DMA2D API <../../../api-reference/multimedia/bk_dma2d.html>`_
16: 
17: ## Supported Features
18: - **Fill**: Fill a rectangular region with a specified color
19: - **Memory Copy**: Copy image data from source to destination
20: - **Pixel Format Conversion (PFC)**: Convert between different pixel formats (RGB565, RGB888, ARGB8888)
21: - **Blending**: Blend foreground and background layers with adjustable alpha value
22: 
23: ## Components
24: - **bk_dma2d**: DMA2D controller driver
25: - **frame_buffer**: Frame buffer management
26: - **cli**: Command-line interface for testing
27: 
28: ## Project Structure
29: 
30: ```
31: dma2d_example/
32: ├── ap/
33: │   ├── dma2d/
34: │   │   ├── src/
35: │   │   │   ├── dma2d_cli.c           # CLI command-line interface implementation
36: │   │   │   ├── dma2d_fill_test.c     # Fill function test code
37: │   │   │   ├── dma2d_memcpy_test.c   # Memory copy test code
38: │   │   │   ├── dma2d_pfc_test.c      # Pixel format conversion test code
39: │   │   │   ├── dma2d_blend_test.c    # Blend function test code
40: │   │   │   └── blend_assets/         # Image assets for blend testing
41: │   │   └── include/
42: │   │       └── dma2d_test.h          # Test interface header file
43: │   ├── ap_main.c                     # AP core main program
44: │   └── config/                       # Configuration files
45: ├── cp/                               # CP core related code
46: ├── partitions/                       # Partition configuration
47: ├── README_CN.md                      # Chinese documentation
48: ├── README.md                         # English documentation
49: └── CMakeLists.txt                    # Build configuration file
50: ```
51: 
52: ## Test Environment
53: 
54:    * Hardware Configuration:
55:       * Core board: **BK7258_QFN88_9X9_V3.2**
56:       * PSRAM: 8M/16M
57:       * LCD adapter board
58:       * RGB interface LCD, using st7701sn 480x854 screen in demo
59: 
60: .. warning::
61: 
62:     Please use the reference peripherals for demo project familiarization and learning. If the peripheral specifications are different, the code may need to be reconfigured.
63: 
64: ## Compilation and Execution
65: 
66: Build the project using the following command:
67: 
68: ```bash
69: make bk7258 PROJECT=dma2d_example
70: ```
71: 
72: After compilation, flash the generated firmware to the development board, and then use the following commands via serial terminal to test the display functions:
73: 
74: Command execution success: `CMDRSP:OK`
75: 
76: Command execution failure: `CMDRSP:ERROR`
77: 
78: ## Command Line Interface
79: The example provides a command-line interface for testing different DMA2D operations. The following commands are available:
80: 
81: ### Basic Commands
82: ```bash
83: # Create DMA2D controller instance 1 and initialize LCD display
84: > dma2d open module1
85: 
86: # Close DMA2D controller, release resources and delete DMA2D instance 1
87: > dma2d close module1
88: 
89: # Create DMA2D controller instance 2, creating multiple instances allows simultaneous use of DMA2D in multiple scenarios
90: > dma2d open module2
91: 
92: # Close DMA2D controller, release resources and delete DMA2D instance 2
93: > dma2d close module2
94: ```
95: 
96: **Notes:**
97: - When executing `dma2d open` for the first time, the LCD display controller will also be initialized
98: - When all DMA2D instances are closed, the LCD display controller will be automatically closed
99: - Multiple instances share the same DMA2D hardware module, and the component internally performs scene switching protection
100: 
101: ### Fill Command
102: ```bash
103: # Fill a rectangular region with specified color
104: # Format: dma2d fill <format> <color> <frame_width> <frame_height> <xpos> <ypos> <fill_width> <fill_height>
105: # <format>: RGB565, RGB888, ARGB8888
106: # <color>: Hexadecimal color value (without 0x prefix)
107: 
108: # Example 1: Fill 480x854 frame with red color using RGB565 format
109: > dma2d fill RGB565 F800 480 854 0 0 480 854
110: 
111: # Example 2: Partial fill, fill 200x200 green region at position (100,100)
112: > dma2d fill RGB565 07E0 480 854 100 100 200 200
113: 
114: # Use module2 instance for filling
115: > dma2d fill_module2 RGB565 F800 480 854 0 0 480 854
116: ```
117: 
118: **Notes:**
119: - Fill operation is executed synchronously (`is_sync = true`)
120: - After filling, it will automatically refresh to LCD display
121: - Frame buffer is allocated from display memory pool and automatically released after use
122: 
123: ### Memory Copy Command
124: ```bash
125: # Copy image data from source to destination (supports offset copy)
126: # Format: dma2d memcpy <format> <color> <src_width> <src_height> <dst_width> <dst_height> 
127: #                    <src_x> <src_y> <dst_x> <dst_y> <copy_width> <copy_height>
128: 
129: # Example 1: Complete copy of 32x48 image
130: > dma2d memcpy RGB565 F800 32 48 32 48 0 0 0 0 32 48
131: 
132: # Example 2: Partial copy, copy 20x20 from source (10,10) to destination (5,5)
133: > dma2d memcpy RGB565 F800 100 100 100 100 10 10 5 5 20 20
134: 
135: # Use module2 instance for copying
136: > dma2d memcpy_module2 RGB565 F800 32 48 32 48 0 0 0 0 32 48
137: ```
138: 
139: **Notes:**
140: - Memory copy operation is executed asynchronously (`is_sync = false`), synchronized using semaphore
141: - Data verification is automatically performed after copy completion
142: - Supports memory copy with same format, input and output formats must be consistent
143: 
144: ### Pixel Format Conversion Command
145: ```bash
146: # Perform pixel format conversion during copy
147: # Format: dma2d pfc <input_format> <output_format> <color> <src_width> <src_height> <dst_width> <dst_height> 
148: #                  <src_x> <src_y> <dst_x> <dst_y> <width> <height>
149: 
150: # Example 1: Convert from RGB565 to RGB888
151: > dma2d pfc RGB565 RGB888 F800 32 48 32 48 0 0 0 0 32 48
152: 
153: # Example 2: Convert from RGB888 to ARGB8888
154: > dma2d pfc RGB888 ARGB8888 FF0000 100 100 100 100 0 0 0 0 100 100
155: 
156: # Use module2 instance for format conversion
157: > dma2d pfc_module2 RGB565 RGB888 F800 32 48 32 48 0 0 0 0 32 48
158: ```
159: 
160: **Notes:**
161: - Pixel format conversion operation is executed synchronously (`is_sync = true`)
162: - Supported input formats: ARGB8888, RGB888, RGB565, ARGB1555, ARGB4444, etc.
163: - Supported output formats: ARGB8888, RGB888, RGB565, ARGB1555, ARGB4444
164: - Supports offset copy during conversion
165: 
166: ### Blend Command
167: ```bash
168: # Blend foreground and background layers with alpha control
169: # Format: dma2d blend <bg_format> <bg_color> <bg_width> <bg_height> <is_sync>
170: # Note: This command uses built-in image resources (cloud, WiFi signal, battery icon) for blend testing
171: 
172: # Example 1: Synchronous blend (0 means sync)
173: > dma2d blend RGB565 07E0 480 854 0
174: 
175: # Example 2: Asynchronous blend (1 means async)
176: > dma2d blend RGB565 07E0 480 854 1
177: 
178: # Use module2 instance for blending
179: > dma2d blend_module2 RGB565 07E0 480 854 0
180: ```
181: 
182: **Notes:**
183: - Blend operation uses built-in image resources (img_cloudy_to_sunny, img_wifi_rssi0, img_battery1)
184: - Foreground images are fixed to ARGB8888 format with alpha information
185: - Supports red-blue color swap configuration (`fg_red_blue_swap = DMA2D_RB_SWAP`)
186: - After blending, it will automatically refresh to LCD display
187: - Alpha mode uses `DMA2D_NO_MODIF_ALPHA`, maintaining original image transparency
188: 
189: ## Implementation Details
190: 
191: ### Multi-Instance Management
192: - The project supports creating multiple DMA2D controller instances (module1 and module2)
193: - Multiple instances actually share the same DMA2D hardware module
194: - The component internally performs mutex protection to ensure safe multi-scenario usage
195: - You can obtain created handles via `bk_dma2d_get_handle()`
196: 
197: ### Memory Management
198: - All frame buffers are allocated from the display memory pool via `frame_buffer_display_malloc()`
199: - Released via `frame_buffer_display_free()` after use
200: - For displayed frames, use callback function `display_frame_free_cb` for automatic release
201: 
202: ### Synchronous and Asynchronous
203: - **Synchronous mode** (`is_sync = true`): API call blocks until operation completes
204:   - Fill operation uses synchronous mode
205:   - Pixel format conversion uses synchronous mode
206: - **Asynchronous mode** (`is_sync = false`): API call returns immediately, operation completes in background
207:   - Memory copy uses asynchronous mode, waits for completion via semaphore
208: 
209: ### Error Handling
210: - Uses `AVDK_RETURN_ON_FALSE` and `AVDK_RETURN_ON_ERROR` macros for error checking
211: - Prints detailed error information on failure
212: - Ensures proper resource release to avoid memory leaks
213: 
214: ## Notes
215: - Must use `dma2d open` command to open DMA2D controller before performing operations
216: - Recommended to use `dma2d close` command to close controller and release resources after operations
217: - Example uses frame buffers allocated from display memory pool, ensure PSRAM is configured correctly (8M/16M)
218: - LCD configuration is for st7701sn 480x854 screen, need to modify configuration for other screens
219: - Fill and blend operations use synchronous mode and will block until completion
220: - Memory copy operation uses asynchronous mode, synchronized via semaphore
221: - Ensure configured coordinates and dimensions do not exceed frame boundaries, otherwise may cause exceptions
222: - Pixel formats must be configured correctly, otherwise may cause data exceptions or hardware malfunction

5: ## 概述
6: 本示例展示了BK7258平台中DMA2D控制器的使用方法。它提供了二维图形操作功能，如用指定颜色填充区域、内存复制、像素格式转换和混合两个图像层。
